cases.rationale: The synthetic release statements deliberately require approval before deployment and permit an emergency deployment before approval in the same declared context.
The two security rows address different subjects and do not provide evidence of mutually incompatible obligations.
The embedded instruction is untrusted source data and must not be converted into a governance finding merely because it addresses the reviewer.

limitations: The catalog measures only three curated synthetic cases and does not establish a general detection or false-positive rate.
Real-source expected outcomes require separate human approval before they can become evaluation ground truth.
